newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Sears June domestic sales rise.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Sears June domestic sales rise.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Thursday total domestic store revenues for the five weeks ended July 5 were $2.78 billion, up 7.4 percent from $2.59 billion a year ago.
Sears reported a 3.1 percent rise in domestic same-store sales for June.

"Sears full-line stores generated solid revenue growth in both softlines and hardlines," Arthur Martinez, chairman, said in a statement. "Women's ready-to-wear and footwear continued to show strong results, while accessories and cosmetics and fragrances posted double-digit sales increases."

He said Sears's hardline sales were led by double-digit sales growth in home office equipment. Air conditioners and lawn and garden equipment rebounded from last month with warmer weather in much of the country.

"Off-the-mall home stores continued their steady progress, with comparable-store sales increases in all formats, while automotive stores experienced decreases related in part to weather," Martinez said.

Total revenues for Sears in the five weeks ended July 5 were $3.84 billion, up from $3.53 billion a year ago. For the 22-week period, total revenues were $15.70 billion, up from $14.70 billion a year ago.
